mapper.select: SELECT * FROM rom_db WHERE system_id = #{systemId} AND REPLACE(serial, '-', '') = REPLACE(#{serial}, '-', '') LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM rom_db WHERE system_id = #{systemId} AND (serial = #{prefix} OR serial LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '-%') OR serial LIKE CONCAT('%-', #{prefix}, '-%') OR serial LIKE CONCAT('%-', #{prefix})) LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM rom_db WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM rom_db WHERE system_id = #{systemId} AND rom_file_norm = #{romFile} ORDER BY platform LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rom_db (system_id, platform, crc32, serial, md5, sha1, game_name, game_name_jp, game_name_cn, region, source, developer, publisher, releaseyear, genre, rom_file, rom_file_norm) VALUES (#{systemId}, #{platform}, #{crc32}, #{serial}, #{md5}, #{sha1}, #{gameName}, #{gameNameJp}, #{gameNameCn}, #{region}, #{source}, #{developer}, #{publisher}, #{releaseyear}, #{genre}, #{romFile}, #{romFileNorm})

INSERT INTO rom_db (system_id, platform, crc32, serial, md5, sha1, game_name, game_name_jp, game_name_cn, region, source, developer, publisher, releaseyear, genre, rom_file, rom_file_norm) VALUES
(#{item.systemId}, #{item.platform}, #{item.crc32}, #{item.serial}, #{item.md5}, #{item.sha1}, #{item.gameName}, #{item.gameNameJp}, #{item.gameNameCn}, #{item.region}, #{item.source}, #{item.developer}, #{item.publisher}, #{item.releaseyear}, #{item.genre}, #{item.romFile}, #{item.romFileNorm})
mapper.select: SELECT platform, system_id AS systemId, COUNT(*) AS count FROM rom_db GROUP BY platform, system_id ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT platform, system_id AS systemId, COUNT(*) AS totalRows, SUM(CASE WHEN game_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(game_name) <> '' AND ((crc32 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(crc32) <> '') OR (serial IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(serial) <> '')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS validRows FROM rom_db GROUP BY platform, system_id ORDER BY platform
SELECT system_id AS systemId, COUNT(*) AS count FROM rom_db WHERE system_id > 0 GROUP BY system_id ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS count FROM rom_db GROUP BY source ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rom_db WHERE platform = #{platform}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rom_db WHERE platform = #{platform} AND source = #{source}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rom_db
SELECT * FROM rom_db
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rom_db WHERE system_id = #{systemId}
SELECT * FROM rom_db WHERE system_id = #{systemId}
SELECT * FROM rom_db WHERE platform = #{platform}
SELECT * FROM rom_db WHERE LOWER(game_name) LIKE LOWER('%' || #{keyword} || '%') ORDER BY system_id DESC, game_name LIMIT #{limit}
